prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1233; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was stopped at the light when struck from behind by a third-party vehicle. Police report requested. Insured reports neck stiffness, no airbag deployment. Photos of both vehicles requested from insured.

Entry 2: Third-party carrier acknowledged liability coverage and assigned its own file number. Claimant confirmed to be represented by counsel. All further contact with claimant to route through attorney's office per firm's letter of representation. Recorded statement from insured obtained and filed.

Entry 3: Claimant's attorney submitted medical authorization and reports indicating a knee injury, with treatment including imaging and physical therapy referral. Records reviewed. Bodily injury evaluation pending receipt of complete treatment notes and billing itemization.

Entry 4: Vehicle damage appraisal completed for both vehicles. Rear bumper, trunk lid, and tail lamp assembly on insured vehicle assessed for repair. Repair estimate received from preferred shop and reviewed. Rental coverage confirmed for the insured while repairs are pending.

Entry 5: Attorney's office requested status update on the knee injury demand package. Advised that the file is under active review and that supporting documentation is still outstanding. Follow-up diary set for next week. Supervisor notified that the claim is represented and may escalate to negotiation.
